name: vibld
tagline: Describe a site or app; get a real React project you own
description: vibld turns a conversation into a conventional codebase. Ask for three design directions or name one of 20+ style presets. vibld writes the choice into a DESIGN.md spec, builds a React + TypeScript project on Vite with Tailwind v4 and shadcn/ui, then checks the files against that spec (colors, fonts, breakpoints, alt text, reduced motion). Preview it privately, export a zip, open a GitHub pull request, or publish in two presses. The output has no vibld dependency and no account check at runtime. The core is Apache-2.0 and self-hostable on Cloudflare Workers. Public beta. Free plan; Build $19/mo; Ship $49/mo.
